cmd.description: 📖 Lists all available Pingway bot commands and instructions.

title: 📖 Pingway Commands Guide
description:
🌐 **Manage Pingway in your browser!** Server settings and personal settings at **{url}**

Here is everything Pingway can do:

market.name: 💰 Market Board
market.value:
**/price <item>** — Cross-world prices across your Data Centers.
**/datacenter** — Choose your Data Centers (used everywhere).
**/marketalert** — DMs listings 80%+ below the usual price (every minute by default; change the DM interval on the website).

perks.name: 💜 Supporter Perks
perks.value:
**/bestsellers** — Top selling items on your world or data center.
**/buysell** — Popular items cheaper on another world than on yours.
**/retainers** — Your watched retainers and their undercut items.
Settings: website → Retainers → Market tools. Perks: 10 points a month (vote on top.gg for points).

status.name: 🌍 Status & Timers
status.value:
**/status** — World status, and DM alerts for your world.
**/timer** — Daily/weekly resets, housing lottery, release countdowns.
**/todo** — Your daily & weekly checklist.
**/firmament** — Personal Skyrise Celebration timer with DM.

party.name: 🎯 Party & Raids
party.value:
**/pf** — Party Finder listings with role & job slots.
**/raid** — 7-day raid schedule from Google Sheets.
**/poll** — Polls with role-limited voting and results.

character.name: 🪪 Character
character.value:
**/ign** — Your character card with Lodestone info & QR code.
**/ignconfig** — Link Lodestone, main job, photos, Tomestone & FFLogs.

games.name: 🃏 Games
games.value:
**/trivia** — Guess the FFXIV word of the day (6 difficulties), earn bits, keep your streak.
**/sciondex** — Recruit NPCs, build a party, fight bosses.
**/nissi** — TEA Nissi mechanics quiz.

ai.name: 🤖 AI Assistant
ai.value:
Only in the AI channel an admin set with **/ailistenhere** (one per server). Chat naturally, e.g.
*"Remind me to do roulettes in 2 hours"* · *"Add task Buy Pots"* · *"Show my task list"*
Say **release recollection** to wipe the short chat memory.

admin.name: 🛠️ Admin
admin.value:
**/ailistenhere** — Move AI chat to this channel (run it again there to turn it off).
**/notifhere** — Set this channel for Pingway notifications.
**/welcomehere** — Post welcome cards for new members in this channel (`action: off` to stop).
**/clean** — Bulk-delete messages (also older than 14 days).
**/honeypot** — "Do not chat here" channel that removes hacked spam accounts.
**/logger** — Log command usage to a Google Sheet.
🌐 On the website: **Reaction Roles**, **Tickets** (help desk) and **FFXIV News** channels.

other.name: 📨 Other
other.value:
**/clearbotdms** — Clean up Pingway's messages in your DMs.
**/pingway** — Choose Pingway's language for you (e.g. `/pingway language: English`, or Auto for your Discord app language).
**/help** — This guide.

footer: Pingway FFXIV Discord Bot • Developed by River Zola
